_notice: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Every person, school, email, WeChat id and meeting link in this file is invented. Names pair an ordinary given name with a Greek-letter surname so they cannot be mistaken for real people, and all addresses use the reserved example.org domain. Never replace this file with real tutor or student information: real data belongs only in an export the coordinator keeps privately.

_hardCases.quietPairing: pair_15 (Kit Lambda / Rui Chi) last met 2026-06-21 — over four weeks before asOf.
_hardCases.tutorAtCapacity: p_t05, p_t01, p_t04, p_t06 and p_t09 are each at the maximum they set for themselves.
_hardCases.studentWithNoViableTutor: p_s20 — weekday-only availability, wants a subject nobody teaches, at a level few tutors take.
_hardCases.dateLineEdgeCase: pair_12 — tutor free Sat 20:00-22:00 America/Los_Angeles, student free Sun 11:00-13:00 Asia/Shanghai. Same hour, two different calendar days.
_hardCases.twoStudentsOneIdealTutor: p_s06 and p_s19 have identical goals, level and availability. Only p_t05 fits either, and p_t05 caps at one student.
_hardCases.noDstTutor: p_t07 is in America/Phoenix, which never changes clocks.
_hardCases.unloggedSessions: The final weekend of pair_01, pair_04, pair_09 and pair_12 is scheduled but not logged (occurred: null, loggedAt: null) — the tutor dashboard nudge points at these.
_hardCases.notAcceptingStudents: p_t01, p_t04, p_t05, p_t06, p_t09 and p_t12 have acceptingStudents false, which is separate from being inactive.
_hardCases.midnightSpanningAvailability: Students in band E are free 22:00-01:00 Asia/Shanghai, a window that crosses local midnight.
